title: The Objective Is the Bottleneck: Latent World Models Encode What Their Planners Cannot Use
abstract: arXiv:2608.12959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models are judged by how well they predict, so when planning fails at long horizons the natural reading is that the predictor degrades. On a reproduction of LeWorldModel on TwoRoom we show the binding constraint is the planner's objective instead.   The predictor is not the limit: its imagined state seventy-five environment steps ahead is still only 0.189 as wrong as assuming the world froze, while the planner never imagines beyond twenty-five. The objective is. Cross-entropy-method planning minimises squared latent distance, which tracks true distance at r = 0.426, saturates by about eighty arena units and decreases beyond a hundred and twenty, so moving away from the goal can lower the cost. The information is present throughout: a ridge probe recovers position from the frozen embedding at R^2 0.9922.   The pathology is the method's, not one reimplementation's. translated_title: 目标函数是瓶颈：潜在世界模型编码了其规划器无法利用的信息
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.12959v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：潜在世界模型通过其预测能力来评判，因此当规划在长时域上失败时，自然的解读是预测器性能下降。在对LeWorldModel在TwoRoom上的复现中，我们表明约束瓶颈反而是规划器的目标函数。预测器并非限制因素：其想象状态在七十五个环境步骤后，其误差仍仅为假设世界冻结时的0.189，而规划器从未想象超过二十五步。目标函数才是问题所在。交叉熵方法规划最小化潜在距离的平方，该距离与实际距离的相关性为r=0.426，在约八十个竞技场单位处饱和，并在超过一百二十后下降，因此远离目标可能降低代价。信息全程存在：从冻结嵌入中通过岭探针恢复位置，R²为0.9922。该病理现象是方法本身的，而非特定重实现的问题。它在作者发布的权重中存在，并跨多种设置出现。
tldr: 该论文揭示潜在世界模型在长时域规划中的失败并非源于预测器精度，而是规划目标函数设计不当，导致其无法有效利用编码的丰富位置信息。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that failures in long-horizon planning with latent world models stem not from predictor inaccuracy but from a poorly designed planning objective that fails to leverage the encoded rich positional information.
